Lambent Armor is a set of [[Bard]] specific armor obtained through quests offered in the [[The Temple of Solusek Ro]]. The full set (with one bracer) gives:

{{ItemStats
|ac=89
|str=4
|sta=5
|dex=5
|agi=5
|wis=0
|int=5
|cha=9
|hp=25
|mana=0
|svp=4
|svm=4
|svd=4
|svf=4
|svc=4
}}

The level range for the quests are around the low 20s to mid 30s depending on your resources. Each piece requires a [[Lambent Stone]] (drops from Hill Giants, Griffons ~level 33) which can bought from higher level players (around 20-35pp). The quests are offered by Walthin Fireweaver and Cryssia Stardreamer.

'''Note:'''  A seven-piece visible set of Lambent armor costs approximately 1600pp to quest when purchasing gems and lambent stones from vendors.

==[[Cryssia Stardreamer]]==

'''Faction note: Please be at least Indifferent and when you hail she should give you the quest information. If below indifferent she will eat your quest items.'''

Quests that Cryssia will complete, Turn in these items to her.
[[File:npc_cryssia_stardreamer.png|right|Cryssia Stardreamer]]

===Lambent Breastplate===
{{CheckboxList}}
*[[Gypsy Lute]] - [[a gypsy musician]] (lvl 29) in [[Castle Mistmoore]]
*[[Basalt Carapace]] - [[a basalt gargoyle]] (lvl 33) in [[Lower Guk]]
*[[Lambent Ruby]] - [[Lambent Stone]] and two [[Ruby|Rubies]] to [[Vilissia]]

===Lambent Helm===

*[[Mudwater Rune]] - [[A Lizard Zealot]] and [[A Lizard Fanatic]] (lvls 32-34) in [[Cazic Thule]]
*[[Opoline Helm]] - [[a deepwater goblin]] (lvl 36) in [[Oasis of Marr]] and [[Lake Rathetear]]
*[[Lambent Star Ruby]] - [[Lambent Stone]] and two [[Star Ruby|Star Rubies]] to [[Genni]]

===Lambent Vambraces===

*[[Fiery Vambraces]] - [[Solusek Champion]] (lvl 28-30) in [[Solusek's Eye]]
*[[Rune of the One Eye]] (Top) - [[Choon]] (lvl 30) in [[West Karana]]
*[[Lambent Sapphire]] - [[Lambent Stone]] and two [[Sapphire|Sapphires]] to [[Gardern]]

===Lambent Bracers===

*[[Dark-boned Bracelet]] - [[A Greater Dark Bone]] (lvl 26-30) in [[Unrest]]
*[[Griffenne Charm]] - [[a griffenne]] (lvl 23) in [[North Karana]]
*[[Lambent Fire Opal]] - [[Lambent Stone]] and two [[Fire Opal|Fire Opals]] to [[Ostorm]]
